title: Variation and Hausdorff dimension of fractional Wiener-Weierstrass bridges
summary: Fractional Wiener--Weierstrass bridges are a class of Gaussian processes obtained by replacing trigonometric functions in the construction of classical Weierstrass functions by fractional Brownian bridges. A number of their sample path properties were derived in Schied--Zhang (2024,2026). The analysis in these papers left several open questions, most of which are addressed here.
